_comment: Overrides merged over packaging/meta.json by tools/build_var.py (all other fields, incl. licenseType, come from meta.json unchanged).
description: AIBody Person plugin: the AI's body on a Person atom - speech playback with lip sync, expressions, morphs, gestures, poses, idle motion and breathing. Needs d0n.AIBodySession (Session Plugins) and the companion app.
instructions: Select a Person atom > Plugins tab > Add Plugin > AddonPackages > d0n.AIBodyPerson.<version>:/Custom/Scripts/d0n/AIBody/AIBodyPerson.cslist. Needs d0n.AIBodySession as session plugin and the companion. See https://github.com/d0n/vam_plugin
